title: Repeat a Set Number of Times: for Loops and range()
concepts: running total in a for loop
TypeError with a float in range()

ai_pair_moment.flaw: Asha asked the AI to rewrite her 10-stamp loyalty card with a for loop and keep the same output. The AI said it prints the same 10 lines, but it used range(1, 10), which stops before 10: the card has 9 stamps and the second FREE TEA is missing. range(1, 11) fixes it.

changes: Lists are not used, because they arrive in Chapter 11; every loop goes over a range() or a string.
continue, a loop's else clause and nested loops are left out to keep one new idea per step.
str.isdigit() and the in operator are not used; Step 3 counts hyphens with ==.

The AI section adds video-only verified files: ai_stamps_mine.py (Asha's while version), ai_stamps_size.py and ai_stamps_size_fixed.py (Debug stage: range(1, size + 1) with size still a string, then the fixed run) and ai_stamps_improve.py (Improve stage: the AI's range(10) version, which also changed the text).
outstanding_issues: The error reports in Mistakes 2 and 4 show the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path to the file appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
